honesty.title: Our honesty commitment
honesty.body: AntiSismo amplifies official alerts and does not replace them. No system can guarantee zero failures: we use several sources, verification and continuous monitoring to warn you as early as possible. Always follow the instructions of the authorities.

guides.title: Guides
guides.before.title: Before an earthquake
guides.before.1: Find a safe spot in every room: under a sturdy table and away from windows.
guides.before.2: Secure tall furniture and heavy objects to the wall.
guides.before.3: Prepare an emergency kit: water, flashlight, radio, first-aid kit, medicines and copies of documents.
guides.before.4: Agree with your family on a meeting point and a contact outside the city.
guides.during.title: During an earthquake
guides.during.1: Drop, cover and hold on until the shaking stops.
guides.during.2: If you are in bed, stay there and protect your head with a pillow.
guides.during.3: Stay away from windows, glass and objects that could fall.
guides.during.4: Do not use elevators or run outside while the ground is shaking.
guides.during.5: If you are on the coast and the earthquake is strong or long, go to high ground as soon as it stops.
guides.after.title: After an earthquake
guides.after.1: Check for injured people and give first aid if you know how.
guides.after.2: Expect aftershocks: if it shakes again, drop, cover and hold on again.
guides.after.3: If you smell gas, do not turn on lights or light fires; get out and notify the authorities.
guides.after.4: Use text messages instead of calls so the lines are not overloaded.
guides.after.5: Follow only the instructions of official authorities.
